detail.longDescription: The employee onboarding period is filled with information, forms, and meetings. It can get overwhelming—and not just for the new hires, but for managers and HR reps too. The right employee onboarding software can make this transition easier. To help you find the best employee onboarding platform, I tested the most popular onboarding apps.
